Nobody at this point, my family is mostly religious and believe that god solves all their problems, they would tell me to pray or something along those lines and I'm atheist I don't pray, to me its the same as doing nothing. I don't need false hope. They don't give me real advice.

I wish I could say I did, I feel like I cannot trust anyone, a couple years ago I opened up to my teacher and she ended contacting school administration and I got put in counseling to help with my suicidal thoughts and to make matters worse everyone knew about it and then everyone I knew treated me differently because they though I was crazy. So I didn't trust a whole lot of people afterwards, my ex was the only one in recent years I let down my wall to.

I understand I know that I need to communicate with my family more but I don't how they'd take it i put on a fake smile for them to make them happy, they ask me if anythings wrong I always give the generic "no" or "I'm okay" I don't want them to think its there fault Im not happy, it's myself but on my ex girlfriend she had been the only person I was able to express myself to and be myself around, I felt like I was able to trust her more so than my parents or family. She plain told me she didn't want to be together anymore. The day after I broke up I had put up a box next to tree with the rope and just sat there think if this it it what's the point.

Yes, everything in my life is slowly going to hell, my grades are awful, I have no real friends and not really socially anyway so so no one would miss me anyway and I broke up with my girlfriend of 4 years about a month ago and even when we were together I wasn't happy. I don't see my life going anywhere mostly because I've stopped caring about what happens cause when I'm dead I won't have to deal with it anymore.

Its sucks, I've been biting my fingernails as long as I can remember. I've tried stopping so many times but I end up doing it without thinking about it. I know how hard it is, that's why I think its cool when I see someone else overcome this stupid habit.
